mapper.update: UPDATE TimeCardSummaryInfo SET yearWeek = #{yearWeek}, totalHours = #{totalHours}, status=#{status}, lastModifiedOn=now() WHERE tcId=#{tcId} and empId=#{empId}

UPDATE TimeCardDetails SET projectId = #{projectId}, activityId = #{activityId}, workingDay = #{workingDay}, workingDate = #{workingDate}, workingHours = #{workingHours}, comments = #{comments}, status = #{status}, addedOn = #{addedOn}, lastModifiedOn = now(), taskDetails=#{taskDetails} WHERE tcdId=#{tcdId} and tcId = #{tcId} and workingDay= #{workingDay}
mapper.select: select ifnull((select tcId from timecardsummaryinfo where empId= #{empId} and (((weekStart<= #{weekStart} or weekStart= #{weekStart} ) and (weekend>= #{weekEnd} or weekend=#{weekEnd} )) or (( weekStart >= #{weekStart} or weekStart= #{weekStart} ) and (weekend>= #{weekStart} or weekend<=#{weekStart}) and (weekStart<=#{weekStart} OR weekStart=#{weekStart} )) or ((weekStart<#{weekStart} or weekStart=#{weekStart} ) and (weekend<#{weekEnd} or weekend=#{weekEnd} ) and (weekend>#{weekStart} or weekend=#{weekEnd}))) limit 0,1),'-1') from dual

select tcId,ifnull(weekStart,' ') as weekstartDT,ifnull(weekEnd,' ') as weekEndDT, ifnull(status,' ') as status, ifnull(concat(date_format(weekStart,'%d %b'),' to ',date_format(weekend,'%d %b')),' ') WeekPeriod, ifnull(totalHours,' ') totalHour, ifnull((select group_concat(distinct concat(firstName,' ',lastName )) from timecardapprovaldetails tcad, timecarddetails tcd,employeeinfo where tcd.tcId=tcsi.tcid and tcad.tcdId=tcd.tcdid and empId=approverId ),' ') managerName ,ifnull(status,' ') statusGrid,ifnull((select group_concat(distinct tcad.comments) from timecardapprovaldetails tcad , timecarddetails tcd where tcd.tcId=tcsi.tcid and tcad.tcdId= tcd.tcdid ),' ') managerComment from timecardsummaryinfo tcsi where empId=#{empId};
